items.text: Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to report any bugs they've encountered! With your help, we've been able to keep the Emperor's crusade free of nasty bugs and xenos!
Please continue to report any bugs you find while playing using our bug report form found at the top of this page:
Achievements - Fixed Mission Complete not being unlocked when the conditions were met
Achievements - Fixed Purification Complete not being unlocked when the conditions were met
Achievements - Fixed Steam Deck not triggering achievements when conditions were met
Achievements - Added logic to trigger achievements on Main Menu retroactively if the user has save files that meet achievement unlock criteria
Purity Seals - Fixed Purity Seals being uncollected when collecting it then loading an earlier save
Purity Seals - Fixed Purity Seals visual collected state resetting after game restart
Purity Seals - Fixed Purity Seals collected in Campaign not being counted towards achievements
Automap - Fixed Automap’s player icon briefly appearing in front of the player after loading
Automap - Fixed Nav Guide trail never fading in the Automap
Automap - Fixed visual bugs in the Automap for multiple levels
Nav Guide - Fixed trail not correctly leading the player for multiple levels
Nav Guide - Fixed Nav Guide continuously pinging audio with Toggle enabled
Nav Guide - Fixed Nav Guide only pinging once with Toggle disabled
Aura of Doom - Fixed Aura of Doom’s overlay making it difficult to see
Gamepad - Fixed aim assist behaving erratically when look sensitivity was set high
Both Characters - Fixed health/faith not regenerating to a consistent round number
Both Characters - Fixed audio bug when taunting and reloading the Meltagun
Both Characters - Fixed player character not falling to ground on death
Both Characters - Fixed Taunt being unusable after loading in some circumstances
Both Characters - Fixed an instance of weapons with the Machine Spirit being removed on load
Malum - Fixed Grenade icon remaining lit when cancelling action with Obliterating Charge
Malum - Fixed Obliterating Charge VFX and animation playing on load
Malum - Fixed Malum’s shoulder trim colour in a cinematic
Malum - Fixed Frag Cannon’s damage being inflated when upgraded with Machine Spirit
Malum - Fixed aim sensitivity changing when loading a save during Obliterating Charge
Nyra - Fixed Nyra sometimes appearing to sound like Malum when jumping or mantling
Nyra - Fixed Condemnor Stakethrower sometimes not damaging the Lord of Skulls
Nyra - Fixed Nyra’s hands disappearing if taunting immediately after throwing a Melta Bomb
Nyra - Fixed Nyra’s hands disappearing when loading a save created during a taunt
Nyra - Fixed camera roll not resetting after disabling ‘Camera Strafe Roll’ whilst camera is rolled
Nyra - Fixed Melta Bombs damage being inflated when shot
All NPCs - Fixed issue where NPCs could appear alive and playing animations after death
All NPCs - Fixed overkilled enemy gore changing size after loading
All NPCs - Fixed multiple enemies not having SFX whilst taunting
All NPCs - Gore is now correctly destroyed when falling out of the world
Vashtorr - Fixed issues preventing Vashtorr’s healing pylons functioning after save/load
Vashtorr - Fixed issues causing Vashtorr’s healing pylons to disappear or have no health bars
Vashtorr - Fixed issues allowing players to destroy Vashtorr’s healing pylons prematurely
Vashtorr - Prevented Vashtorr from being dragged with the Grav-Cannon
Vashtorr - Fixed Vashtorr’s portal persisting when loading
Vashtorr - Fixed Vashtorr’s beam attack passing through geometry
Traitor Guards - Fixed occurrence where enemies could fire blank bullets
Helbrutes - Fixed enemy occasionally teleporting into the air
Hades Cannon Forgefiend - Fixed attack where sometimes Forgefiend wouldn’t fire
Maulerfiend - Fixed pull attack not pulling player
Tormentors & Daemonettes - Fixed issues where these enemies sometimes wouldn’t react to the player
Meltagun Tormentor - Fixed weapon impact VFX not appearing
Bloodletter - Fixed sword leap having a delay before impact
Khorne Berzerkers - Fixed rage VFX persisting incorrectly when loading
World Eater Terminators - Improved gibs for specific variant
Lord of Skulls - Fixed enemy scooping the player up on to its body
Lord of Skulls - Fixed enemy’s head spinning when mounted
Lesser Plague Toad - Fixed enemy spit projectile not firing correctly
Krieg Snipers - Fixed allies sometimes firing blank bullets
All Levels - Fixed Purge notifications not appearing after loading
All Levels - Fixed hazards status/damage effects not being reapplied after loading
Shattered Station - Fixed skybox being visible when restarting level
The Bastion - Fixed some geometry the player could get stuck behind in various places
Festering Bog - Prevented sequence break where the player could skip the Red Key as Nyra
The Vile Root - Adjusted the difficulty of the boss encounter and added Autosaves
The Vile Root - Fixed issue preventing player from backtracking after the Poxwalker ambush
The Trenches - Fixed crash when the user loaded an earlier save
The Trenches - Fixed NPCs walking into walls
Munitions Mayhem - Fixed enemies getting stuck under elevator
Munitions Mayhem - Fixed Encounter Waves failing to load
Chaos in the City - Fixed crash at end of level
Chaos in the City - Prevented spawning an infinite number of Krieg Troopers (sorry)
Chaos in the City - Prevented sequence break where the player could skip the Red Key area
Chaos in the City - Fixed missing smoke VFX when High Quality Effects setting is disabled
Dilapidated Prison - Adjusted the difficulty of the final purge sequence
Dilapidated Prison - Fixed geometry the player could get stuck inside
Dilapidated Prison - Fixed the door to the Purity Seal
Blood Fortress - Fixed visual artifacts when walking around corners
Blood Cascade - Fixed player getting stuck inside moving walls
Blood Cascade - Fixed spike hitboxes persisting on load despite not being visible
Blood Machine - Fixed audio issue when loading last save
Blood Machine - Fixed lift switches appearing active whilst in the inactive state
Underhive - Prevented sequence break where the player could skip the Red Key area
Daemonic Symphony - Fixed suspended cages losing their walls after loading
Daemonic Symphony - Fixed player falling through the elevator after loading
Crushing Heresy - Fixed Forgefiend's shields remaining active after defeat
Crushing Heresy - Fixed crushers remaining active after the purge
Rapid Ascent - Fixed autosaves spawning the player over the instant kill hazard zone
Train Wrecked - Fixed softlock when user it forced out of bounds by incoming train
Tank Manufactorum - Fixed enemies walking into the tank whilst it's stationary
God in the Machine - Added new fall zones to prevent the player from falling out of bounds
First Time User Experience - Fixed Brightness calibration not correctly representing the game
Death Screen - Fixed softlock when user rapidly presses the confirmation button
Level Select - Fixed completion times resetting when completing subsequent Campaign levels
Level Select - Fixed level completion time not updating correctly and always displaying as ‘0:00’
Level Select - Fixed level completion time occasionally showing incorrect data
Main Menu - Fixed screen flashing black when loading Main Menu
Audio Options - Added Player Character volume slider
Level Complete Screen - Added a delay to avoid accidentally skipping to next level
All Menus - Added SFX to the Back buttons
All Menus - Fixed various localisation issues
As you can see, the team here at Auroch Digital have been incredibly busy and not just on Warhammer 40,000 : Boltgun 2!
This week we also launched Warhammer Survivors and we’ve already released one patch and created a roadmap for future updates:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629822/cd33656a51a08b09e4354b73ce5f0f1b1a0a16dc.png"]
Learn more about what's in store for Warhammer Survivors here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3669620/view/649241729050870167?l=english"]
Changed the Continue button on the Main Menu to exclusively load Campaign save files
Added Crosshair options to change the Opacity, Scale and to turn it into a dot
Fixed a major performance issue on the Nurgle Nightmare chapter
Fixed a fatal error crash on launch for users with an Intel Core Ultra CPU and outdated drivers
Fixed a softlock on the Level complete screen after deleting your Autosaves
Fixed a softlock with the Lord of Skulls where they could not be killed if you saved and loaded immediately after shooting the neck weak point
Fixed a softlock with the Lord of Skulls where their arm would land on you upon dying
Fixed a softlock on the last purge of The Trenches where a Daemonette could phase out of bounds and become inaccessible
Please continue to report any bugs you find while playing using our bug report form found at the top of this page: https://aurochdigital.com/warhammer-40000-boltgun-2-faq
